generate_anchors: generate 3D anchors for object detection from a grid size and point cloud range config
assign_targets: assign ground truth box targets to anchors using ATSS or axis aligned target assigner
get_cls_layer_loss: compute the classification layer loss using sigmoid focal loss for anchor head predictions
get_box_reg_layer_loss: compute the bounding box regression and direction classification loss for anchor head predictions
generate_predicted_boxes: decode predicted box offsets and direction bins into final 3D bounding box predictions
